answer: Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The orchard holds work receipts rather than names, so the spiral of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, released only after three unrelated confirmations, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. What survives to the tide is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
